mostWorthwhile.text: Using the spindle on the copied DNA was most worthwhile: the time-strip showed how the copies separated into two nuclei before the cell itself divided.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the spindle was less clear as a decision. The goal named the ingredients, but I didn't understand how they would make it until the result showed the fibres.

surprise.text: I was surprised that each copied DNA helix contained one old strand and one new strand.

arbitrary.text: The spindle pairing felt a little like following a named recipe rather than figuring it out independently, although its purpose was clear from the goal.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: seeing how the daughter cells might become muscle or lining cells is a useful next question, though I hope the new terms are explained.
